test_policy.notes: The first-year page says ACT or SAT scores are optional through summer 2028 (considered if provided). Admission is holistic: academic rigor, GPA, grade trend, class rank, test scores if provided, and non-academic factors.

requirements.notes: International undergraduates apply with the shared Universities of Wisconsin (UW) Application; the $50 international admissions processing fee is paid after submitting, before a decision. (The first-year page also accepts the Common App for new freshmen, but the international page lists only the UW Application.) Needs a passport copy and secondary and post-secondary records with English translations. No minimum GPA is published. High school course expectations: 4 English, 3 math, 3 social science, 3 science, 4 electives. Conditional (ESL) degree admission is available for students who need ESL before starting a major.

deadlines.label: International undergraduate application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Application opens Aug. 1, 2026; review starts as soon as a complete application arrives. Spring 2028 deadline is Nov. 15, 2027. International students already in F-1 status are considered after the deadline case by case. The first-year page lists a Jan. 1, 2027 priority deadline for fall 2027 first-year applicants; the international page does not mention it.

deadlines.label: #YouAreWelcomeHere Scholarship application closes (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Separate application (essay of 500-1,000 words or a 2-5 minute video), open Jan. 1 to Apr. 1, 2027; winners notified by Apr. 15, 2027. Not available to ESL Institute students. The International Student Tuition Scholarship needs no application.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The requirement may be waived for applicants from English-speaking countries, decided by the Admissions Office after applying. Other options: completing UW-Stout's ESL program, or transfer credit equivalent to English 101 with a C or higher from a regionally accredited school. Duolingo applicants must do extra ESL Institute testing and may be required to take ESL courses. The page also links a table of all English proficiency options that could not be read.

english.notes: Exams taken on or after 2026-01-21; the page does not name the 1-6 scale.
IELTS One Skill Retake also accepted.
Minimum 115 overall and 90 or higher in each sub-score. The ESL Institute may require additional testing and ESL courses for Duolingo applicants.

aid.notes: All international degree applicants are automatically considered for the International Student Tuition Scholarship: up to $5,000 per year for first-year and transfer students with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher (4.0 scale), renewable each semester (15 credits per semester, 3.0 GPA, global-involvement requirement). Not available for ESL Institute courses. A limited number of #YouAreWelcomeHere scholarships (50% of nonresident tuition, excluding fees, renewable up to four years) need a separate application; the two awards cannot be combined. ESL pathway: the ESL Institute (five levels) admits with no minimum English test score; conditional degree students must finish the high-advanced level with a 2.0 ESL GPA before starting degree courses.

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the UW-Stout pages read; select UW-Stout in the College Board search.
